description: Implement a cleanup mechanism that automatically removes references to deleted recipe ingredients from recipe steps. When a recipe is updated and ingredients are removed, ensure any step references to those removed ingredients are also removed to maintain data consistency.
functional_requirements: Add logic to the recipe update process that identifies when ingredient references in recipe steps point to ingredients that no longer exist in the recipe
Remove orphaned ingredient references from recipe steps before saving the updated recipe
Ensure the cleanup happens automatically during recipe updates without requiring additional database queries
Add integration tests that verify the cleanup works correctly when ingredients are removed from recipes with step references
